standards.title: Line Operated Three-Phase A.C. Motors (IE Code) — Specification
standards.scope: This standard covers energy efficient three-phase squirrel cage induction motors with rated voltage up to 1000 V and rated output from 0.12 kW to 1000 kW, defining efficiency classes IE1, IE2, IE3, and IE4.

clauses.content: Rated output shall be specified in kilowatts (kW) for continuous duty S1.
The efficiency levels for IE3 motors shall be measured according to IS 15999 (Part 2/Sec 1).
Terminal box protection shall be at least IP 55.
Installation practices shall comply with IS 900.
If equipment is installed in hazardous industrial zones, IS 5571 applies.

references.test_name: Efficiency Determination Test for Three-Phase Motors

references.condition_text: If equipment is installed in hazardous industrial zones

standards.title: Rotating Electrical Machines — Part 2: Methods for Determining Losses and Efficiency from Tests
standards.scope: Applies to rotating electrical machines and establishes methods of determining efficiencies from tests.

clauses.content: Input-output method and summation of losses method shall be used.

references.notes: Circular back-reference to motor standard for test applicability

standards.title: Code of Practice for Installation and Maintenance of Induction Motors
standards.scope: Covers installation, foundation, aligning, and maintenance of induction motors in industrial locations.

clauses.content: Motors should be installed in well-ventilated areas free from excessive dust.

standards.title: Three-Phase Induction Motors — Specification
standards.scope: This standard covers the requirements and tests for three-phase induction motors for industrial purposes with voltages up to 1000 V and outputs from 0.12 kW to 1000 kW.

clauses.content: Standard rated output shall be in kilowatts for standard voltages 415 V.
Duty cycles shall be designated as S1 to S8 according to IEC conventions.

standards.title: Single-Phase Small A.C. Motors for Household Appliances — Specification
standards.scope: This standard specifies requirements and methods of test for single-phase a.c. motors intended exclusively for domestic and household appliances.

clauses.content: Covers fractional horsepower motors exclusively for domestic use up to 240 V.

standards.title: Polyethylene Pipes for Water Supply — Specification
standards.scope: This standard specifies requirements for high density polyethylene (HDPE) pipes manufactured from PE 63, PE 80, and PE 100 grades for municipal and industrial potable water conveyance.

clauses.content: Pipes shall be extruded from virgin PE 100 or PE 80 material containing carbon black 2.0 to 2.5 percent.
Pressure rating shall correspond to PN 6, PN 10, or PN 16 with standard dimension ratios (SDR).

standards.title: Hot Rolled Medium and High Tensile Structural Steel — Specification
standards.scope: Covers the requirements of steel plates, sections, flats, bars, and beams for use in structural fabrication and engineering construction including bridges and buildings.

clauses.content: Grade E250 quality A steel shall have a minimum yield strength of 250 MPa for thickness up to 20 mm.
Charpy V-notch impact test shall be conducted at room temperature or 0 deg C as specified.

standards.title: Ordinary Portland Cement, 53 Grade — Specification
standards.scope: Covers the manufacture and chemical and physical requirements of 53 grade ordinary Portland cement for high strength prestressed and reinforced concrete works.

clauses.content: Compressive strength after 28 days curing shall not be less than 53 MPa.
Initial setting time shall not be less than 30 minutes, and final setting time not more than 600 minutes.

standards.title: Outdoor/Indoor Type Oil Immersed Distribution Transformers up to and Including 2500 kVA, 33 kV — Specification
standards.scope: Covers thermal, electrical and mechanical design requirements for 3-phase mineral oil immersed distribution transformers up to 2500 kVA.

clauses.content: Maximum total losses at 50% and 100% loading shall conform strictly to Standard Energy Efficiency Levels (Level 1, 2, or 3).
Winding temperature rise above ambient 50 deg C shall not exceed 50 deg C when tested in accordance with IS 2026.

references.notes: Uninhibited and Inhibited Mineral Insulating Oils

standards.title: Polyvinyl Chloride (PVC) Insulated Cables for Working Voltages up to and Including 1100 V — Specification
standards.scope: Specifies requirements for single and multicore cables with copper or aluminium conductors insulated with PVC for rated voltage up to 1100 V AC.
standards.qco_reference: Electrical Wires and Cables (Quality Control) Order, 2023

clauses.content: Conductors shall be plain annealed high-conductivity copper or grade H2 aluminium conforming to IS 8130.
Insulation thickness and spark test voltage shall withstand testing per IS 10810.

standards.title: Historical Obsolete Specification for Steam Locomotives
standards.scope: Old retired specification for coal-fired steam boiler locomotives.
